briefdescription.para: Specialisation of DMat for ARingGFFlint matrices, backed by FLINT's fq_zech_mat (Zech-log) routines.

detaileddescription.para: Matrices over GF(p^n) for small-field cases: stores entries in FLINT's discrete-log encoding and delegates linear-algebra primitives to the matching fq_zech_mat_* functions. The Zech tables make addition cheap, so this is the preferred dense GF(p^n) backend for small fields.
